children: Sadot Group appointed Michael Murray as its chief executive and chief financial officer, succeeding Chagay Ravid.

Ravid resigned as CEO and interim CFO and was appointed executive director of the company, it said in a Thursday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. He continues to serve as a member of the board of directors.
Murray joins from GBT Tokenize Corp., where has been CEO since June 2022. He was also CEO and principal financial officer of GBT Technologies between November 2024 and February 2026.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
